verdict.rationale: Circle documents one first-party event-triggered automation: CCTP can trigger automated actions on the destination blockchain after assets arrive. That is a narrow, protocol-specific hook rather than a general rules engine. Webhooks only notify your app so it can react, which makes them a developer building block, and agent spending policies are an adjacent control; neither earns credit here. Missing for 10: a general user-definable rule/trigger system across events, documentation on how rules are configured, coverage beyond CCTP transfers, and hands-on corroboration.
